title: Nico Caprez Leads $500B Nvidia Financing Drive for Customers
summary:
Jensen Huang's son-in-law is coordinating an initiative to ensure the company's clients have sufficient capital to purchase AI hardware. This $500 billion financing push, led by VP Nico Caprez, helps buyers find the funding, sales leads, and power necessary to sustain their chip orders. Caprez also manages multibillion dollar relationships with neocloud providers and is working to convert GPUs into a recognized financial asset.

Caprez joined Nvidia 2.5 years ago and has since rapidly ascended to the role of vice president after marrying Huang's daughter, Madison. He serves as a "consigliere" to the chief executive and acts as the primary contact for neocloud accounts, according to reporting from The Information based on interviews with more than 12 employees.
